site: BDM Warren Steel - Pond #5 and 56-inch Hot Mill Lagoon

candidate_structure.positive_area: Pond #5 controlled fill containing blended residuals beneath fine-grained cover soil and topsoil
candidate_structure.negative_area: 56-inch Hot Mill Lagoon, residuals removed to the bentonite layer and confirmatory samples accepted before slag backfill, topsoil, and seeding

positive_depth_evidence.survey_compared_surfaces: existing base surface and final clay fill surface

confounders: active demolition and redevelopment of the surrounding former steel mill
later federal removal actions at the abandoned facility
large buildings, roads, rail and industrial infrastructure immediately adjacent to the lagoon areas

fatal_reasons: The confirmed-negative lagoon lacks a final surveyed boundary; the public map labels the lagoon limit approximate.
The positive survey provides surfaces and total volume but no public pointwise final thickness grid or stated numerical survey uncertainty.
The surrounding site underwent continuing demolition, remediation and redevelopment, so a clean stable Sentinel-1 observation interval is not established.
The two areas share topsoil and seeding but not the same near-surface substrate: fine-grained soil at Pond #5 versus slag backfill at the negative lagoon.
